name: Echo
description: Routes each request across specialist open-weight models behind a single endpoint, allocating compute per task to cut inference cost while holding output quality.

skills.name: Per-Request Routing
skills.description: Selects the best specialist open-weight model for each request based on task type and quality targets.

skills.name: Compute Allocation
skills.description: Spends more inference compute on hard prompts and less on easy ones to balance cost against answer quality.

skills.name: Unified Endpoint
skills.description: Exposes the whole model pool through one API surface so callers switch routing strategy without code changes.
